QuestInfo.name: Clairvoyant
QuestInfo.0: The rumor has it #b#p2091001##k is #b#m250000000##k is #t1142271#. Find out the truth from #p2091001#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2091001# says that he's not #t1142271#, but simply a practitioner of Taoist magic. He thinks #t1142271# is a better fit for you...if you have enough Insight to defeat the #r#o7220002##k.\n\n#o7220002##r #a295181##k

0.0: Hello, #h0#. Hm? You heard that I'm clairvoyant? Not at all! I do know some small bit of magic, but I'm not clairvoyant by any means.
0.1: You, on the other hand, have Insight that verges on clairvoyance. You should have more confidence in yourself! I believe you could even defeat the #o7220002#... Why don't you take up the challenge?

yes.0: #r#o7220002##k lives in the Goblin Forest, where he enjoys harassing Explorers who pass through. I'm confident that someone with as much Insight as you will have no problem defeating him.

1.0: So, you've defeated the #o7220002#. I used my magic to watch you from here. Your Insight could easily be mistaken for clairvoyance... It has been an honor to meet someone with your abilities.

mob.0: Have you not defeated the #r#o7220002##k yet? With your Insight, you should be able to see through his defenses.
